title: Warning call after a Howard Stern producer's call

tellings.quote: on the other end of the line said, "Drop the story. Don't go on the Sahara Stern and stop talking about it."

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA, the US government's eavesdropping agency, hired him to talk with aliens, says that about two years after his book came out he got a call from a producer of Howard Stern's radio show. Soon after, he says, someone else called his office and told him: "Drop the story. Don't go on the Stern show and stop talking about it." He told this to podcast host Jesse Michels as a sign that someone wanted him silent.
